claims: The March 28, 2026 PBC on Prime Video PPV featuring Sebastian Fundora vs. Keith Thurman is in Las Vegas.
Yoenis Tellez vs. Brian Mendoza is a 10-round Super Welterweight bout.
Yoenli Hernandez vs. Terrell Gausha is a 10-round Middleweight bout.
Gurgen Hovhannisyan vs. Cesar Navarro is a 10-round Heavyweight bout.
The PPV starts at 8:00 PM ET on Prime Video and PPV.com.
Preliminary fights will be available for free on Prime Video.
Early results from the event indicate a knockout win for Gurgen Hovhannisyan.
Early results from the event indicate a TKO victory for Yoenli Hernandez.
